ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio (approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels) on the visible surface, characterized by a dominant white central field and dark peripheral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupying the interior of both lobes. Black pigmentation is concentrated along the central notch region and follows the trailing edge. Distinct vertical black striations are visible on the medial portion of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees; the vertex point is slightly obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge; profile is significantly modified at the distal tips by protruding three-dimensional calcified structures.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the upper trailing margins leading to elevated distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast, tan-colored pixel groups (barnacles) localized on the outer distal tips of both lobes. A single dark focal spot is visible on the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous vertical and oblique dark linear pixel disruptions across both lobes; a prominent intersecting 'X-shaped' mark is visible on the lower quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal margins; multiple parallel linear rake marks across the white ventral surface indicative of past physical interaction.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique intersecting linear scar pattern on the lower-left lobe forming a distinctive cross-like geometric shape.
